_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Manual Schedule and Status Report
summary: Provides information to the Government to permit program managers to determine if Technical Manuals are being prepared and delivered in accordance with approved contract schedules and to take timely corrective action when discrepancies are identified.
use_relationship:
The Technical Manual (TM) Schedule and Status Report provides information to the Government to permit program managers to determine if TMs are being prepared and delivered in accordance with approved contract schedules, and to take timely corrective action in the event discrepancies are identified.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This data item shall not be procured when this information is provided by any other report supplied by the same contractor.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TM Schedule and Status Report shall be presented in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The TM Schedule and Status Report shall contain the requirements of the approved contract schedule and shall contain current status of TM development/maintenance tasks.  The report shall include all information related to current scheduled contract requirements and contract accomplishments.  The report shall also include the following:

children.title: Name and address of contractor and contract number
Applicable Technical Manual Contract Requirement (TMCR) number(s), TM identification number(s), and title(s) of the TM(s) covered within the report
Document Type Definition (DTD) Public Identifier(s) used to develop the TM(s) covered by the report
Contract milestones, activities, and accomplishments
children.content: The TM Schedule and Status Report shall identify contract milestones, activities, and accomplishments related to TM development, review, and submission from contract award to the completion of the contract.  The report shall also identify other programmatic events (e.g., design schedules, ship delivery dates, equipment installation, initial training conduct, equipment production schedules) that relate to or impact TM milestones.

children.title: Additional report content
children.content: The TM Schedule and Status Report shall also contain the following:

children.title: Status of TM milestones and TM development and quality assurance events and deliverables versus schedule
Progress made against TM milestones during the reporting period and an explanation of slippages and get well dates
Identification of problem areas and points of special interest
children.content: Identification of problem areas and points of special interest affecting technical or scheduling elements, with background and any recommendations for solutions.  Results, positive or negative, related to previously-identified problem areas with conclusions and recommendations.

children.title: A summary of communications/correspondence that resulted in contract clarification
A summary of any significant changes to the contractor's organization or method of operation
